title: record page History: an activity row with no actor at all (actor_id and actor_name both null: seed and system writes) reads "Unknown user" with a "?" avatar — it reads System
body:
Filing gate ① (a product defect, measured on `main`), filed on the maintainer's word (chat, 2026-10-15, session `session_019YFzJp4o8Ck4NsT1toC4UP`, seat account os-bill): the seat ran a functional audit of the HotCRM console on objectui `main` `720f6d4` (report, private to the maintainer: https://claude.ai/artifact/XPrn5eZMsQaKUgasMJEMmR, finding F9, figure 10), and the maintainer answered 「同意开卡，使用 pm-dispatch 创建卡片」. Quota note: the audit's cards exceed the filing gate's three-per-fire quota on that word, which approved the report's card list as a set.

Parent: #12444. The third pin of #12067 (closed by PR #12070) covers the row this card measures: "a row with neither renders the existing fallback". This card changes what that fallback says. Blocks nothing; nothing blocks it.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:ui` lane's next dispatch (seat post #9800), one dev round in `@object-ui/plugin-detail` (`HistoryTimeline.tsx`, `renderers/record-history.tsx`) and the ten `@object-ui/i18n` packs, size S.

**Dedupe** (MCP `search_issues`, scope objectstack-ai/objectui, all states, read 2026-10-15T14:14Z): "record history timeline Unknown user for system or seed writes actor missing show System" → 3, all closed: #12067 (rows with `actor_id` and no `actor_name` read Unknown user; fixed by PR #12070, which resolves `actor_id`), #11701, #11697 (the audit log's actor column). None is this card: #12067 left the no-actor row on the fallback by design and this card names that row.

## What happens

The HotCRM lead "Mira Costa" → History shows three entries, each with a "?" avatar and the name "Unknown user": 「UPDATED · Lead Owner: ∅ → Dev Admin」, 「UPDATED · Updated Lead "Mira Costa - Atlas Construction"」, 「CREATED · Created Lead "Mira Costa - Atlas Construction"」. A reader is told a person they cannot identify changed the record; the writer was the seed's owner backfill, with no user in context.

## Readings (objectui `origin/main` `720f6d4`, read 2026-10-15T14:15Z)

1. API reading (HotCRM backend, admin): `GET /api/v1/data/sys_activity?filter=["object_name","=","crm_lead"]&sort=-timestamp` → 28 rows, each with `actor_id: null`, `actor_name: null`, `actor_avatar_url: null`, `created_by: null`; `summary` "Lead Owner: ∅ → Dev Admin", `metadata` `{"old":{"owner_id":null},"new":{"owner_id":"ZgyhVWT4…"}}`. A login's `sys_user` row, by contrast, carries `actor_id` and `actor_name` "Dev Admin".
2. `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-history.tsx` line 147 reads `schema.unknownUserText`; line 217 passes it to `HistoryTimeline`; `HistoryTimeline.tsx` lines 60, 168 and 213: the fallback label for an entry with no user, defaulting to the "Unknown user" string (i18n `unknownUser` at `packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts` line 1468 is the shorter "Unknown" used elsewhere).
3. PR #12070 (#12067): an entry with `actor_id` only now resolves the user's name; an entry with neither keeps the fallback.

## What to build

1. An entry whose row carries neither `actor_id` nor `actor_name` is a system write: it renders the label "System" (new i18n key in all ten packs, e.g. `detail.history.systemActor`) with a system glyph (a cog or the platform mark) in place of the "?" avatar, never a person-shaped unknown.
2. "Unknown user" stays for the only case that is unknown: an `actor_id` the user lookup cannot resolve (a deleted user).
3. `unknownUserText` keeps overriding the unknown case; a new `systemActorText` override is not added unless the schema already has a slot for it.

## Acceptance

- `HistoryTimeline` tests: a row with no actor renders "System" and the system glyph; a row with an unresolvable `actor_id` renders "Unknown user"; the #12067 pins (resolved `actor_id`, `actor_name` wins) unchanged.
- Browser reading by the landing seat on the HotCRM lead above: the three seed entries read "System".
- `pnpm test` from the repo root green on the affected files; `check:i18n-keys` green; a changeset (patch) for `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/i18n`.

## Out of scope

- The writer (objectstack's seed and hooks setting an actor); the audit log browser's actor column (#11701).

Attribution: written by the domain:ui seat in session `session_019YFzJp4o8Ck4NsT1toC4UP` (account os-bill) on the maintainer's words quoted above.
